repositories.boundary: Use as structural reference only; do not copy sample character assets into Su Shixia.

repositories.boundary: Useful runtime reference; still requires Live2D Cubism Core licensing review before distribution.

repositories.boundary: Workflow reference only; no VTube Studio app assets or API assumptions in the core package.

repositories.boundary: Borrow the workflow concept; authored Su Shixia motion data remains local to Athena.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: Idle, listen, think, return
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Use official Haru motion timing as a low-amplitude presence reference for breathing, eye motion, hair settling, and recovery.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: Timing and grouping reference only; Su Shixia needs authored curves and her own layered art.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: TTS speech and voice response
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Use official sample model and sound package layout to keep voice-triggered motion, expression, and audio timing separate.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: Athena TTS drives mouth parameters locally; do not import sample voice clips.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: Head, hair, face, ear, neck reactions
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Combine official small head motions with trigger-style reaction design for shy, startled, and affectionate micro-reactions.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: No third-party character motion is copied; sensitive-zone responses stay mode-gated.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: Hands, arms, wave, drag
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Use official sample gesture clips and Pixi hit-test patterns as references for hand wave, arm recoil, and pointer-driven drag follow.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: Independent arm motion still requires real mesh deformers; Lite overlay hands are preview-only.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: Clothing, torso, skirt, legs
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Use official motion and physics package shape as a timing reference for weight shift, garment adjustment, and recovery to idle.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: Private opt-in zones remain semantic and runtime-gated; public package must not include explicit assets.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: Turn preview and future multi-view
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Use official parameterized motion format and open puppet-system contrast to plan front/profile/back transitions.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: Current `TurnPreview` is a 2.5D hint; true turn requires separate source packages and orientation hit maps.

motionReferenceFamilies.label: Future gaze, blink, expression input
motionReferenceFamilies.use: Use ecosystem references for future camera or tracking input that can drive gaze, blink, expression, and head angle parameters.
motionReferenceFamilies.boundary: Not a current dependency and not required for the Lite preview.

adoptedDecisions: Keep official Live2D samples as package and timing references, not copied assets.
Use Pixi and VTube Studio ecosystem ideas for hit-test, motion trigger, and parameter-control design.
Map every Su Shixia motion group to at least one reference family before authoring Cubism motion clips.
Keep face-tracking and alternate rigging ecosystems as future research, not current dependencies.
Do not claim a genuine Cubism default until Editor export and Cubism Web proof replace the current Lite preview.
